preconditions: victim gRPC client uses the rls_experimental load-balancing policy
attacker influences the RLS lookup result to grow the endpoint list across two consecutive lookups (malicious/compromised RLS server, DNS rebinding, or MITM)

evidence.observed_result: vulnerable loop dereferences e1_list[1] of a size-1 vector (canary_hit=TRUE); fixed loop bounds-checks i>=size first (canary_hit=false)

real_exploit.backend: verbatim reproduction of the vulnerable loop (std::vector<EndpointAddresses> + ForEach) with a canary EndpointAddresses placed in the slot immediately after e1_list's single element
real_exploit.demonstrated: the vulnerable loop reads past the end of a size-1 endpoint vector (index 1, hitting the canary) when the new endpoint list has more entries than the old; the fixed loop's in-loop bounds check (i >= e1_list.size()) prevents the read
